Class ServletTestExecutionListener

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.test.context.support.AbstractTestExecutionListener
org.springframework.test.context.web.ServletTestExecutionListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
Ordered, TestExecutionListener
public class ServletTestExecutionListener extends AbstractTestExecutionListener
TestExecutionListener which provides mock Servlet API support to WebApplicationContexts loaded by the Spring TestContext Framework.

具体来说，ServletTestExecutionListener 会在测试实例准备和每个测试方法之前通过 Spring Web 的 RequestContextHolder 设置线程本地状态，并根据 WebApplicationContext 中存在的 MockServletContext 创建 MockHttpServletRequest、MockHttpServletResponse 和 ServletWebRequest。该监听器还确保可以将 MockHttpServletResponse 和 ServletWebRequest 注入到测试实例中，并且在测试完成后，该监听器会清理线程本地状态。

请注意，ServletTestExecutionListener 默认已启用，但如果 测试类 未使用 @WebAppConfiguration 进行注解，则通常不会执行任何操作。有关详细信息，请参阅此类的各个方法的 JavaDoc。

Since:
3.2
Author:
Sam Brannen, Phillip Webb

    Method
    Description
    void
    afterTestMethod(TestContext testContext)
    如果提供的TestContext中的RESET_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE的值为Boolean.TRUE，则此方法将：(1) 通过重置 Spring Web 的RequestContextHolder来清理每个测试方法之后的线程本地状态；以及 (2) 通过将测试上下文中的DependencyInjectionTestExecutionListener.REINJECT_DEPENDENCIES_ATTRIBUTE设置为true，确保为后续测试向测试实例注入新的模拟对象。
    void
    beforeTestMethod(TestContext testContext)
    在每个测试方法之前通过 Spring Web 的 RequestContextHolder 设置线程本地状态，但仅当 测试类 标注了 @WebAppConfiguration 时才会执行。
    final int
    getOrder()

    • RESET_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE

      public static final String RESET_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE
      Attribute name for a TestContext attribute which indicates whether the ServletTestExecutionListener should reset Spring Web's RequestContextHolder in afterTestMethod(TestContext).

      允许的取值包括Boolean.TRUE和Boolean.FALSE。

    • POPULATED_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE

      public static final String POPULATED_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE
      Attribute name for a TestContext attribute which indicates that ServletTestExecutionListener has already populated Spring Web's RequestContextHolder.

      允许的取值包括Boolean.TRUE和Boolean.FALSE。

    • CREATED_BY_THE_TESTCONTEXT_FRAMEWORK

      public static final String CREATED_BY_THE_TESTCONTEXT_FRAMEWORK
      Attribute name for a request attribute which indicates that the MockHttpServletRequest stored in the RequestAttributes in Spring Web's RequestContextHolder was created by the TestContext framework.

      允许的取值包括Boolean.TRUE和Boolean.FALSE。

    • ACTIVATE_LISTENER

      public static final String ACTIVATE_LISTENER
      Attribute name for a TestContext attribute which indicates that the ServletTestExecutionListener should be activated. When not set to true, activation occurs when the test class is annotated with @WebAppConfiguration.

      允许的取值包括Boolean.TRUE和Boolean.FALSE。

      Since:

    • afterTestMethod

      public void afterTestMethod(TestContext testContext) throws Exception
      If the RESET_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE in the supplied TestContext has a value of Boolean.TRUE, this method will (1) clean up thread-local state after each test method by resetting Spring Web's RequestContextHolder and (2) ensure that new mocks are injected into the test instance for subsequent tests by setting the DependencyInjectionTestExecutionListener.REINJECT_DEPENDENCIES_ATTRIBUTE in the test context to true.

      `RESET_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE` 和 `POPULATED_REQUEST_CONTEXT_HOLDER_ATTRIBUTE` 将随后从测试上下文中移除，无论其值如何。

      Specified by:
      `afterTestMethod` 接口 `TestExecutionListener` 中
      Overrides:
      `afterTestMethod` 类中的 `AbstractTestExecutionListener`
      Parameters:
      testContext - 测试方法执行所在的测试上下文；永远不会为 null
      Throws:
      Exception - 允许任何异常传播。
      See Also:
      • TestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext)
